# Hockeydb.com

> Comprehensive hockey statistics and history database covering the NHL, WHA, IHL, and other professional hockey leagues with player records, team histories, and draft information.

Hockeydb.com serves as the definitive online resource for professional hockey statistics, featuring detailed franchise histories, player databases, draft records, and team rosters spanning multiple leagues including the National Hockey League (NHL), World Hockey Association (WHA), and International Hockey League (IHL). The site provides tools like the Player Encoder and extensive searchable records for hockey researchers, fans, and historians.

## Key Topics

- NHL (National Hockey League)
- WHA (World Hockey Association)
- IHL (International Hockey League)
- NHL Draft and Amateur Draft
- Player statistics and records
- Team franchise histories
- Hockey player database
- Team rosters and lineups
- Awards and honors
- NHL Sponsorship System
- Hockey cards and collectibles
- Draft history and information
- Team statistics and records
- Player search tools
- Historical hockey data

## Core Resources

- [Hockeydb.com - Hockey Statistics and History for the NHL and more!](https://hockeydb.com/): Homepage for NHL and WHA hockey statistics, player database, and history
- [NHL and WHA Draft History at Hockeydb.com](https://www.hockeydb.com/ihdb/draft/index.html): NHL and WHA draft history index covering amateur and entry drafts

## NHL Team Histories and Statistics

- [Detroit Red Wings hockey team statistics and history at hockeydb.com](https://www.hockeydb.com/stte/detroit-red-wings-5492.html): Detroit Red Wings NHL team statistics, history, and franchise records
- [Pittsburgh Penguins hockey team statistics and history at hockeydb.com](https://www.hockeydb.com/stte/pittsburgh-penguins-7475.html): Pittsburgh Penguins NHL team statistics, history, and franchise records
- [Toronto Maple Leafs hockey team statistics and history at hockeydb.com](https://www.hockeydb.com/stte/toronto-maple-leafs-8490.html): Toronto Maple Leafs NHL team statistics, history, and franchise records
- [Vancouver Canucks hockey team [NHL] statistics and history at hockeydb.com](https://www.hockeydb.com/stte/vancouver-canucks-8756.html): Vancouver Canucks NHL team statistics, history, and franchise records
